name: Gillette India Ltd
about: Gillette India Limited is engaged in the manufacturing and selling of packaged fast moving consumer goods under its various brands in the grooming and oral care segment. Gillette sells razors and blades, shaving gel, shaving cream, and after shave through various modes like drug stores, departmental stores, grocery stores, mass merchandisers, membership club stores. key_points: Portfolio of well known Brands [1] Gillette, Venus, Braun, Oral B

profile.summary: Gillette India Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of grooming and oral care products in India and internationally. The company operates through grooming, and oral care segment. It offers shaving system and cartridges, blades, toiletries, razors, and other components. The company also offers toothbrushes and oral care products. In addition, the company provides body shaving and trimming; skin care; and shaving gel, shaving cream and after shave; and female grooming products under the Gillette Venus brand name. The company sells its products primarily under the GilletteLabs, SkinGuard Sensitive, Fusion5, MACH3, Disposable Razor, Guard3, and Styler brand names. Gillette India Limited markets and sells its products through mass merchandisers, grocery stores, membership club stores, drug stores, department stores, and high frequency stores. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Mumbai, India.
